h1: Custom V-Neck Vests for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom v-neck vests in bulk for your team. Perfect for branding with logos. Shop at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: V-neck vests offer a polished, professional look that sets your team apart from standard crewneck styles. Whether you're outfitting a sales team or safety crew, the v-neck design layers cleanly over collared shirts without bunching. Many styles, like the Carhartt® Gilliam Vest or Men's Mesa Vest, accept full-color embroidery or screen printing on the chest and back. Choose from quilted puffers for warmth or lightweight shells for mild weather.
heroAltText: Custom v-neck vests with embroidered logo on chest, ideal for team uniforms and corporate branding.
